mn121:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātu pāsāde.
mn121:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn121:3.1: ekamidaṃ bhante samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati nagarakaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo
mn121:3.2: tattha me bhante bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn121:3.3: suññatā vihārenāhaṃ ānanda etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmīti
mn121:3.4: kacci metaṃ bhante sussutaṃ sugahitaṃ sumanasikataṃ supadhāritanti.
mn121:3.5: taggha te etaṃ ānanda sussutaṃ sugahitaṃ sumanasikataṃ supadhāritaṃ.
mn121:3.6: pubbe cāhaṃ ānanda etarahi ca suññatāvihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi.
mn121:4.1: seyyathāpi ānanda ayaṃ migāramātu pāsādo suñño hatthi gavā ssa valavena suñño jātarūparajatena suñño itthīpurisasannipātena. atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ
mn121:4.3: evameva kho ānanda bhikkhu amanasikaritvā gāmasaññaṃ amanasikaritvā manussasaññaṃ araññasaññaṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:4.4: tassa araññasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
mn121:4.6: ye assu darathā gāmasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi ye assu darathā manussasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ
mn121:4.8: so suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ gāmasaññāyāti pajānāti suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ manussasaññāyāti pajānāti. atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ
mn121:4.10: iti yaṃ hi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ santaṃ idamatthīti pajānāti.
mn121:4.11: evampissa esā ānanda yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
mn121:5.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda bhikkhu amanasikaritvā manussasaññaṃ amanasikaritvā araññasaññaṃ paṭhavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:5.2: tassa paṭhavīsaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
mn121:5.3: seyyathāpi ānanda āsabhacammaṃ saṅkusatena suvihataṃ vigatavalikaṃ
mn121:5.4: evameva kho ānanda bhikkhu yaṃ imissā paṭhaviyā ukkulavikulaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakadhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ amanasikaritvā paṭhavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:5.5: tassa paṭhavīsaññā cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
mn121:5.7: ye assu darathā manussasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi ye assu darathā araññasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ

mn121:9.4: ye assu darathā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi ye assu darathā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ

mn121:10.2: tassa animitte cetosamādhimhi cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
mn121:10.4: ye assu darathā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi ye assu darathā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ

mn121:11.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda bhikkhu amanasikaritvā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ amanasikaritvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:11.2: tassa animitte cetosamādhimhi cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
mn121:11.4: ayaṃ hi kho animitto cetosamādhi abhisaṅkhato abhisañcetayito.
mn121:11.5: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti.
mn121:11.6: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati
mn121:11.8: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn121:12.2: ye assu darathā kāmāsavaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi ye assu darathā bhavāsavaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi ye assu darathā avijjāsavaṃ paṭicca tedha na santi atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ
mn121:12.4: so suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ kāmāsavenāti pajānāti suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ bhavāsavenāti pajānāti suññamidaṃ saññāgataṃ avijjāsavenāti pajānāti. atthi cevidaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ
mn121:12.6: iti yaṃ hi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ santaṃ idamatthīti pajānāti.
mn121:12.7: evamassa esā ānanda yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā paramānuttarā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
mn121:13.1: yepi hi keci ānanda atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja vihariṃsu sabbe te imaṃyeva parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja vihariṃsu.
mn121:13.2: yepi hi keci ānanda anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharissanti sabbe te imaṃyeva parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharissanti.
mn121:13.3: yepi hi keci ānanda etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharanti sabbe te imaṃyeva parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharanti.
mn121:13.4: tasmātiha ānanda parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharissāmāti
mn121:13.7: attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
